title.en: Searching “30”: Which Xingtai Pump Page to Open
title.zh: 搜索“30”时，该打开邢台的哪一张泵页

description.en: A search for 30 at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai can mean Electric 30 or Diesel 30. They print different power and different output. There is no low-pressure 30 page.
description.zh: 在河北品锦机械（邢台）搜索 30，可能是电动30或柴油30。两者的动力和输送量不同。没有低压30这一页。

h1.en: The Number 30 Is Two Catalogue Pages
h1.zh: 数字 30 对应两张目录页

directAnswer.en: If the only clue is “30”, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai has two pump pages, not one. Electric 30 prints a 30 kW motor, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, fine-stone 60 m / 180 m and aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and 60 m / 180 m. There is no page named Electric Low Pressure 30. Choose the path before you ask for a price.
directAnswer.zh: 如果线索只有“30”，河北品锦机械（邢台）有两张泵页，不是一张。电动30印 30 kW 电机、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、细石 60 m / 180 m、13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、60 m / 180 m。没有名为电动低压30的页面。先选定路径再问价格。

body.en: The fine-stone pair is 60 m / 180 m. The aggregate-13 pair is 20 m / 60 m. Maximum aggregate on the sheet is ≤ 3 cm. Weight is 1200 kg and the frame is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Tell Xingtai which distance row you are using. See [/en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/](/en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/).
body.zh: 细石一组是 60 m / 180 m。13 骨料一组是 20 m / 60 m。该页最大骨料为 ≤ 3 cm。重量 1200 kg，外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。告诉邢台你用的是哪一行距离。见 [/zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/)。

heading.zh: 柴油30的说明还写了什么

body.en: The Diesel 30 description attaches “1 cm aggregate” to the 60 m / 180 m pair, and the specification cell prints maximum aggregate 3 cm and below. Those are two published lines. Send your actual maximum stone rather than blending them into a new distance. The frame is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and 2000 kg.
body.zh: 柴油30的说明把“1 cm 骨料”标在 60 m / 180 m 这一组上，规格格子又印最大骨料 3 cm 及以下。这是两条已公布的文字。请发送你的实际最大石子，不要把它们合成一个新距离。外形 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm，重量 2000 kg。

heading.en: Inquiry when the search was only 30
heading.zh: 只搜到 30 时询盘怎么写

body.en: Write the full slug, not the numeral. State grid or diesel. Send stone size and both distances to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Hebei Pinjin Machinery will not price “a 30” without a path.
body.zh: 写完整型号地址，不要只写数字。说明是电网还是柴油。把石子粒径和两个方向的距离发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。河北品锦机械不会对没有路径的“一台 30”报价。

answer.en: Not in this catalogue. Low-pressure pages start at Electric Low Pressure 40 and Electric Low Pressure 60.
answer.zh: 这份目录里没有。低压页从电动低压40和电动低压60开始。

question.zh: 两个 30 都印 20 MPa 吗？

answer.en: Yes. Pressure matches on that one cell. Output, power, weight and frame do not.
answer.zh: 是。压力这一格相同。输送量、动力、重量和外形不相同。

question.en: Which 30 page shares its frame with another pump?
question.zh: 哪一个 30 和另一台泵外形相同？

answer.en: Electric 30 shares 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg with Electric Low Pressure 40. The motors are 30 kW and 37 kW.
answer.zh: 电动30与电动低压40共享外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm 和 1200 kg。电机是 30 kW 和 37 kW。

question.en: Is the price the same because both say 30?
question.zh: 都叫 30 所以价格相同吗？

answer.en: No price is printed for either page. Ask Xingtai.
answer.zh: 两页都没有印价格。请问邢台。
